solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Italian 19ac composed country collection?

indicators.note: composed in the sense of put together anew, so these letters are arranged into a fresh order

parts.note: the answer to 19 across, meaning the pick or best part

explanation.surface: An Italian has composed some cream-themed collection of country songs, perhaps.
explanation.walkthrough: '19ac' stands for its answer, CREAM; its letters join those of ITALIAN as the fodder. The question mark flags the playful definition: a group of nations is a collection of countries.
explanation.definitionFit: The region spans many nations of Central and South America, so it is a whimsical 'collection' of countries.

clue.text: Chimney bulge beginning to open — a pain

parts.note: lum is a Scots and northern English word for a chimney
a bag is a bulge or sagging swelling, as in bags under the eyes

indicators.note: the beginning of the word open supplies only its opening letter

explanation.surface: A sweep finds a bulge in the chimney that starts to open: a real nuisance.
explanation.walkthrough: LUM for chimney is a Scottish word worth remembering; 'beginning to' takes just the first letter of 'open'.
explanation.definitionFit: This is an ache in the lower back, a specific kind of bodily pain.

clue.text: National, say, location for operational staff

definitions.meaning: the National is London's National ..., an example of a playhouse
an operating room in a hospital, where surgical staff work

explanation.surface: The National Theatre, perhaps, as a base for staff in operations.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Operational' points at surgery: the hospital room where operations happen shares the playhouse's name.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means both a playhouse such as the National and a hospital's operating room.

clue.text: What's left for attack following trap

indicators.note: following means the words before it come after the trap piece in the answer

parts.note: a net is a trap for fish or birds
pro means for, in favour of
a fit is an attack or bout, as of coughing

explanation.surface: A hunter wonders what to do next after a trap, ready for the attack.
explanation.definitionFit: The earnings remaining once all costs are deducted are what is left over for the business.

clue.text: Right to stop crush in Slough

indicators.note: to stop is to plug a gap, so the right piece sits inside the crush piece like a stopper

parts.note: to mash is to crush, as potatoes

explanation.surface: Seems to be about a crowd crush in the town of Slough, west of London.
explanation.walkthrough: Slough looks like the Berkshire town; here it is a lower-case bog.
explanation.definitionFit: A slough is a swamp or boggy hollow, so it is a synonym for a wetland.

clue.text: Judge about to release European on the inside

parts.note: re means about or concerning

indicators.note: on the inside means the European piece is placed within the release piece

parts.note: to free is to release

explanation.surface: A judge is about to free a European prisoner held inside.
explanation.definitionFit: An umpire who rules on play in a match is a judge of the game.

clue.text: Artist, stylish, finally resident in Brazilian city

indicators.note: the final letter of the stylish piece goes to reside inside the city piece

parts.note: chic means stylish
Rio de Janeiro, the Brazilian city, shortened as usual

explanation.surface: A stylish artist ends up living in Rio.
explanation.walkthrough: 'finally resident in' sends only the final letter of the stylish word into the city, not the whole word. Giorgio de Chirico is an Italian painter.
explanation.definitionFit: Giorgio de Chirico was the Italian painter of metaphysical cityscapes, so he is an artist.

clue.text: Warmer — presumably not on the peaks?

definitions.text: Warmer — presumably not on the peaks?

parts.words: Warmer — presumably not on the peaks?
parts.note: the clue plays on off-peak electricity, which such a heater uses overnight; read literally, it suggests something warm kept away from mountain tops

explanation.definitionFit: An electric radiator that charges up on cheap off-peak night power and gives heat out by day is a warmer.

clue.text: Shattered stepmother rose thus?

indicators.note: shattered means broken into pieces, so these letters are broken up and rearranged

parts.note: rose as a colour is red

explanation.surface: A shattered stepmother rose up in anger, as one would expect.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Shattered' rearranges STEPMOTHER into SHORTTEMPE, and rose as a colour adds RED. The whole clue also pictures a stepmother rising in a temper, hence the question mark.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone quick to lose their cool and flare up is irritable, as a furious stepmother might be.

clue.text: From idyllic valley, extremely smart example of comedy

parts.note: the Vale of Tempe in Greece was celebrated by poets as an idyllic valley

indicators.note: extremely takes the extreme letters, the first and last, of the word smart

explanation.surface: From a peaceful valley comes a smart example of comedy.
explanation.walkthrough: Tempe, a gorge in Thessaly, became a byword in classical poetry for a beautiful valley.
explanation.definitionFit: Shakespeare's late play about Prospero is classed among his comedies, so it is an example of one.

clue.text: Dashing fighter pilots leading search

indicators.note: leading means the pilots piece goes first, ahead of the search piece

parts.note: the RAF, Britain's Royal Air Force, flies fighters
to fish is to search, as for compliments

explanation.surface: Dashing fighter pilots are at the head of a search mission.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Dashing' looks like a verb of rushing, but it is the adjective, the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: A rakish, devil-may-care manner is dashing in a slightly disreputable way.

clue.text: One taking bait on individual cast?

parts.note: re means on, concerning
an actor is one individual in a cast

explanation.surface: An angler with a single cast is taking bait.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Cast' and 'bait' suggest fishing; the cast is a play's players, and taking bait means rising to provocation.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who rises to a taunt and responds is one who takes the bait, responding as provoked.

clue.text: Runner, girl, not finishing run

indicators.note: not finishing means the girl's name loses its final letter

parts.note: Harriet is a girl's name
R is the cricket abbreviation for run

explanation.surface: A girl running doesn't finish the run.
explanation.definitionFit: A cross-country athlete is called by this name, after the hound bred for chasing hares; a runner.

clue.text: Planet's grand projection

parts.note: G is the abbreviation for grand, a thousand
a lobe is a rounded projection, as of the ear

explanation.surface: A planet makes a grand projection, as in an atlas map.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Projection' suggests map-making, but here it means a protruding part.
explanation.definitionFit: The Earth is often called this, a spherical world, so it stands for a planet.

clue.text: Journalist meeting public after criticism dropped off

indicators.note: after means the journalist and public pieces come after the criticism piece

parts.note: flak is hostile criticism
ED is short for editor, a journalist
out means public, known to all

explanation.surface: A journalist goes public after receiving criticism.
explanation.walkthrough: 'dropped off' reads as fell away; it means fell asleep from exhaustion.
explanation.definitionFit: Collapsing asleep exhausted is dropping off, both being informal for nodding into sleep.

clue.text: Who will have dissected a film about allies

indicators.note: about means around, so the first pieces wrap around the allies piece

parts.note: a mist is a thin film, as on glass
NATO is the alliance of Western allies

explanation.surface: A film about the NATO allies.
explanation.walkthrough: 'film' looks like a movie but means a thin coating.
explanation.definitionFit: A specialist in bodily structure cuts up bodies to study them, so is one who dissects.

clue.text: Breathe erratically when swallowing a large hot drink

indicators.note: swallowing means the jumbled letters take in the other pieces
erratically means irregularly, so these letters are jumbled

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: Someone breathes unevenly while gulping a big hot drink.
explanation.walkthrough: 'erratically' scrambles BREATHE into HERBTEA, which 'when swallowing' opens to take in A and L.
explanation.definitionFit: An infusion of herbs such as chamomile is served steaming, a hot beverage.

clue.text: Area hit badly in old province

indicators.note: badly signals the letters are put together wrongly, so they are rearranged

explanation.surface: An area hit hard in a former province.
explanation.definitionFit: This was a Roman province in the Alps, covering parts of today's Switzerland and Austria; an ancient territory.

clue.text: Outsider, alternatively one who transfers property

parts.note: an alien is an outsider or foreigner
or means alternatively

explanation.surface: An outsider, or perhaps a conveyancer handing over property.
explanation.definitionFit: In law, the person who alienates, conveying title to property to another, is the transferor.

clue.text: Pick great joke, forgetting the opening

indicators.note: forgetting the opening means the first letter of the joke word is dropped

parts.note: a scream is something hilarious, a great joke

explanation.surface: Choose a great joke, but forget how it starts.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Pick' looks like a verb, but it is a noun: the pick of the bunch.
explanation.definitionFit: The best part of anything, as in the elite of society, is its pick.

clue.text: Mostly nutty biscuit

indicators.note: mostly means the word loses its last letter

parts.note: crackers means nutty, crazy

explanation.surface: A biscuit that is mostly nuts.
explanation.definitionFit: A thin, crisp savoury wafer eaten with cheese is a kind of biscuit.

clue.text: Heartbroken, a mourner clutches charm

indicators.note: clutches means the run of words holds the letters within its grasp

explanation.surface: A heartbroken mourner clutches a lucky charm.
explanation.walkthrough: 'charm' looks like a trinket, but it is a verb, to captivate.
explanation.definitionFit: To win someone's love or captivate them is to charm them, a verbal synonym.

clue.text: Formidable internet giant with binary exchange — Google's first

indicators.note: binary uses only 0 and 1, so the 0-shaped letter is exchanged for the 1-shaped letter

parts.note: Amazon is the internet retail giant

indicators.note: first takes the opening letter of Google

explanation.surface: A mighty internet giant swaps binary code, with Google coming first.
explanation.walkthrough: In 'with binary exchange' the binary digits 0 and 1 look like the letters O and I, so AMAZON turns into AMAZIN.
explanation.definitionFit: Formidable in its French sense of terrific, wonderful, matches astonishingly impressive.

clue.text: Favour good stock

parts.note: race means stock, lineage

explanation.surface: A favoured, good stock of investment.
explanation.definitionFit: Goodwill or favour shown to someone is grace, as in being in someone's good graces.

clue.text: Retiring foreign character, loose old salt

indicators.note: retiring means going back, so all these pieces are read backwards

parts.note: eta is a Greek letter, a foreign character
lax means loose

explanation.surface: A retiring foreigner, a loose old sea dog.
explanation.walkthrough: 'salt' suggests a sailor, but it is a chemical salt.
explanation.definitionFit: This is a salt of oxalic acid, found in rhubarb leaves; a chemical compound.

clue.text: Son breaking excellent record around the country

indicators.note: around means the whole thing is turned back to front

parts.note: A1 means excellent, written AI with the figure read as a letter

indicators.note: breaking means the son letter breaks into the record piece

parts.note: a note is a record, as in taking a note

explanation.surface: A son breaks an excellent record touring the country.
explanation.walkthrough: A1 for excellent is written AI, the figure 1 read as the letter I. 'breaking' gives NOTSE, and 'around' reads the whole string backwards.
explanation.definitionFit: This Baltic state is a nation in northern Europe.

clue.text: Mini career break, ultimately a little tedious

indicators.note: ultimately takes the last letter of each of the three words

parts.note: some means a little, as in some bread

explanation.surface: A mini career break is, in the end, a little tedious.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Mini' and 'career' suggest a car; they just supply letters.
explanation.definitionFit: Something annoying or wearisome that irritates is tedious.

clue.text: Using which one might no longer be distressed

definitions.text: Using which one might no longer be distressed

parts.words: Using which one might no longer be distressed
parts.note: distressed is read as dis-tressed, without tresses, that is bald; the product gives the tresses back

explanation.definitionFit: A tonic said to regrow hair on a bald scalp would end the state of having lost one's locks.
